---
applyTo: "docs/**/*.md,README.md,CHANGELOG.md"
---

# Documentation

- Document only what the code shows. Never invent endpoints, options, commands or behaviour.
- `docs/` is written in Spanish; `README.md` and code comments in English. Keep the language of the file you edit.
- Put each shell command in its own fenced `bash` block. Use relative links to files in the repository.
- Changelog entries come only from merged pull requests: link each one, do not invent entries.
